notes: Operating direction (OD) is airport-wide: 25 or 07, never mixed. Landings decide it, headwind preferred.
Tailwind >= 10 kt on the landing direction: change immediately.
0 < tailwind < 10 kt: tolerated up to 30 minutes, then switch to the headwind direction.
Calm or variable wind (no direction): keep the current OD.
Runway 18 (departures only, toward 180) is closed when its tailwind >= 15 kt or its crosswind incl. gusts > 40 kt. Usable in either OD.
